title: Scalar coordinates for smooth purity
statement: Use [def-pur-transport-geometric-indices], [def-pur-transport-compact-support-coordinates]. Bundle each coefficient's existing condensed ring as a scalar-six ring. For a coefficient map commuting with its integral coefficient maps, the first-line scalar comparison is scalar-extension associativity and that commutative triangle. The derived tensor scalar comparison is the canonical monoidal tensorator of derived extension of scalars. For an ordinary line map its degree-zero derived scalar map is obtained by transposing across the scalar adjunction and the recorded single/derived-restriction comparison; the shifted map uses the same adjunction's shift comparison.
